name: NetBird
description: NetBird is a secure networking platform that creates private, peer-to-peer connections between devices using encrypted communication channels. It builds a trusted network layer that allows seamless and direct communication without exposing data to intermediaries. Every connection is protected with modern encryption standards and managed automatically through a zero trust security model that authenticates identities rather than networks.
short_desc: An adaptive client for Zero Trust Networking
author: NetBird

form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
